children: DWF Labs said Bitcoin is not digital gold and tends to track the Nasdaq. According to PANews, Bitcoin has shown its strongest correlation with stocks; since spot ETFs launched in 2020, its correlation with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq has remained around 0.39. When the Nasdaq fell by more than 1%, Bitcoin also declined about three-quarters of the time, while gold fell 57% of the time over the same period. Bitcoin’s correlation with gold has generally been weak, but its 90-day correlation rose to 0.59 in September 2026, a 10-year high.

title: DWF Labs Says Bitcoin Tracks Nasdaq Rather Than Acting as Digital Gold
